headline: Alibaba chairman Joe Tsai says open-source AI is Europe's best route to technology independence.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept; speech of 7 Oct read on a copy of the Bloomberg text.
importance_line: His case for European compute and open-source models affects European governments and businesses first, and it is a company chairman's view rather than a policy.
summary: Bloomberg reports that Joe Tsai, chairman of Alibaba Group, said at the Wave by Vento conference in Turin on Wednesday, 7 Oct 2026, that open-source AI is Europe's best route to technology independence from the US and China. He urged Europe to build its own computing infrastructure to train and run AI models, and said US closed-source labs 'want to be closed'.
notes: Bloomberg page blocked; text read on The Edge Malaysia copy (dated 8 Oct, Bloomberg-style). Event 7 Oct, NEW. The Bloomberg link is the url.
